geometry.checks: All dated vertices round-trip to real NAV/exposure, nearest-date lookup, plot bounds, SVG rounding, linear/log, widths, invalid alignment/values.

scope: Real daily portfolio NAV including cash and receivables, exact calendar dates and nominal exposure, linear/log geometry; no change to financial engine.
display_changes: D is always a separate dashed series, even when its allocation matches A/B/C.
Linear and logarithmic NAV scales use the same amounts, not cumulative percentage returns.
Initial principal is a reference, not an invented pre-cost trading observation.
